description: Réseaux d'Eau Potable et d'Assainissement is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Drinking Water and Sanitation Networks: Channels, Connections, Works, Equipment, Fittings, Lookouts, Valves. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking Water and Sanitation Networks" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2013-08-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
